proof:
Source: parent proof, step 9 (V12, approximate tangent plane: subsequence principle and 'V₀ is determined by τ₀ alone') combined with steps 5–8 and 10, which are supplied by the siblings blowup_limit (BL), constant_planes (CP), weight_ge_one (WG) and plane_integer (PI).
1. θ₀ := θ(a) > 0 since a ∈ M; let η₀' > 0 be the constant of LD_{P,d}.
2. Plane uniqueness (the parent's 'V₀ is determined by τ₀'). If v, v' are orthonormal n-families with β(v) = β(v') for every n-covector β, then span v = span v'. Proof: let Q := span v, Q' := span v' and A the n×n matrix A_{ij} := ⟨v'_i, v_j⟩. The covector β(u) := det(⟨u_i, v_j⟩)_{i,j} (multilinear, alternating, continuous in u) has β(v) = 1, so det A = β(v') = 1. Let L : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ, (Lx)_i := Σ_jA_{ij}x_j = ⟨v'_i, u_x⟩ with u_x := Σ_jx_jv_j ∈ Q, |u_x| = |x|. Then |Lx|² = Σ_i⟨v'_i, u_x⟩² = |p_{Q'}u_x|² ≤ |u_x|² = |x|², so L maps the closed unit ball B̄ ⊆ ℝⁿ into itself, and Lⁿ(L(B̄)) = |det L|·Lⁿ(B̄) = Lⁿ(B̄) (Mathlib Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap). L(B̄) is compact, so B∖L(B̄) (B the open unit ball) is open with Lⁿ(B∖L(B̄)) ≤ Lⁿ(B̄) − Lⁿ(L(B̄)) = 0, hence empty: B ⊆ L(B̄). L is invertible (det L = 1). If |x| = 1 and |Lx| < 1, pick s > 1 with |L(sx)| = s|Lx| < 1; then L(sx) ∈ B ⊆ L(B̄), so sx ∈ B̄, contradicting |sx| = s > 1. Hence |Lx| = |x| for all x, i.e. |p_{Q'}u| = |u| for all u ∈ Q, so Q ⊆ Q'. Orthonormal families are linearly independent, so dim Q = dim Q' = n and Q = Q'.
3. Claim. For every sequence λ_i > 0 with λ_i → 0 there are a strictly increasing φ and an orthonormal v = (v_1, …, v_n) such that ζ(a)(β) = β(v) for all n-covectors β, ∫_{blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M}f dHⁿ → ∫_{span v}f dHⁿ for every continuous compactly supported f, and θ₀ ∈ ℕ.
 (a) Apply (BL) (its hypotheses are exactly ours together with (SL), (RU), (CT), SLIM_{P,d} and the sequence λ_i): φ, ν, C, Γ_k, μ_k, ξ_k with ν finite on compacts, ν(B_R(0)) ≤ ω_nRⁿ and ν(B_R(0)) > 0 for R > 0, C(ω) = ∫θ₀ζ(a)(ω(y))dν(y), ∂C = 0, M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W) for open W, ISP of C, Γ_k ⇀ C, ∂Γ_k = 0, admissible representations (μ_k, ξ_k) of Γ_k with limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K), and, for N_k := blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M, μ_k(ℝ^P∖N_k) = 0, limsup_kHⁿ(N_k ∩ K) ≤ ν(K) and ∫_{N_k}f dHⁿ → ∫f dν.
 (b) Lower density of ν. Apply LD_{P,d} to C with the measure θ₀ν and the constant field ζ(a): ∂C = 0; θ₀ν is finite on compacts; M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W); the constant field is strongly measurable with |ζ(a)(α)| ≤ |α|; C(ω) = θ₀∫ζ(a)(ω)dν = ∫ζ(a)(ω)d(θ₀ν) (integral_smul_measure); C has ISP. So liminf_rθ₀ν(B_r(y))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀' for θ₀ν-a.e., equivalently (θ₀ > 0) ν-a.e., y; multiplication by the finite positive constant θ₀ commutes with liminf in [0, ∞] (ENNReal.liminf_const_mul_of_ne_top), so liminf_rν(B_r(y))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀'/θ₀ for ν-a.e. y.
 (c) Boundary condition. For a test d-form φ: 0 = ∂C(φ) = C(dφ) = θ₀∫ζ(a)(dφ(y))dν, so ∫ζ(a)(dφ(y))dν(y) = 0.
 (d) Apply (CP) with ν, ζ₀ := ζ(a) (|ζ(a)(β)| ≤ |β| and ζ(a)(β₁) = 1 for some |β₁| ≤ 1, as a ∈ M), c := η₀'/θ₀ and (a)–(c): an orthonormal v with ζ(a)(β) = β(v) for all β, N ∈ ℕ, distinct w_1, …, w_N ⊥ span v, α_i ≥ c > 0 with Σ_iα_i ≤ 1, some w_{i₀} = 0, and ν = Σ_iα_iHⁿ⌞{y : y − w_i ∈ V₀}, V₀ := span v. Consequently C(ω) = θ₀∫ω(y)(v)dν.
 (e) Apply (WG) with v, θ₀, N, w, α, ν, C, (Γ_k), (μ_k), (ξ_k) and the sets N_k (all hypotheses are in (a) and (d)): α_i ≥ 1 for all i.
 (f) N ≤ Σ_iα_i ≤ 1 and N ≥ 1 (the index i₀ exists), so N = 1, α_1 = 1 and w_1 = 0; hence ν = Hⁿ⌞V₀.
 (g) By (a), ∫_{N_k}f dHⁿ → ∫f dν = ∫_{V₀}f dHⁿ.
 (h) C(ω) = θ₀∫_{V₀}ω(y)(v)dHⁿ and C has ISP, so (PI) gives θ₀ ∈ ℕ. This proves the claim.
4. The plane. Apply the claim to λ_i := 1/(i + 1) and let v be the resulting orthonormal family, Q := span v. dim Q = n (finrank_span_eq_card for the linearly independent v). ζ(a) is a unit orientation of Q (τ := v, ζ(a)(α) = α(v)), and θ(a) = θ₀ ∈ ℕ.
5. Approximate tangent plane. Let f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), F(r) := ∫_{blowUpMap a r '' M}f dHⁿ and L := ∫_Qf dHⁿ. By the subsequence criterion (Mathlib tendsto_of_subseq_tendsto; 𝓝[>]0 is countably generated) it suffices that every sequence r_j tending to 0 within (0, ∞) has a subsequence along which F → L. Given such r_j, choose j₀ with r_j > 0 for j ≥ j₀ and apply the claim to λ_i := r_{i+j₀} (positive, → 0): a subsequence φ and an orthonormal v' with ζ(a)(β) = β(v') and F(λ_{φ(k)}) → ∫_{span v'}f dHⁿ. Since β(v') = ζ(a)(β) = β(v) for all β, step 2 gives span v' = Q. Thus F(r_{φ(k)+j₀}) → L. Hence F(r) → L as r → 0⁺ for every f ∈ C_c, which together with dim Q = n is HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M a Q. ∎
key_steps: Plane uniqueness: β(v) = β(v') for all n-covectors forces span v = span v' (det = 1 and a volume argument make p_{Q'}|_Q an isometry).
For any blow-up sequence, (BL) gives a limit C = θ₀ζ(a)ν with ISP; LD gives the lower density of ν.
(CP) makes ν a finite sum of parallel planes with ζ(a) = v∧; (WG) gives every weight ≥ 1, so ν = Hⁿ⌞span v; (PI) gives θ(a) ∈ ℕ.
Plane uniqueness and the subsequence criterion give the approximate tangent plane.
